items.title: Suno Bridge: Your DAW, Suno-powered
items.excerpt: Suno launched Bridge, a standalone Mac app in beta that syncs with Ableton Live 12 and generates new instrument and vocal parts that follow the session's tempo, key, chords and groove, dropping them straight onto the timeline within the loop markers.

items.title: 머무르 '꿈꾸던…', AI 활용곡 사상 첫 멜론 '톱 100' 1위
items.excerpt: 작곡과 가창에 AI를 활용한 머무르의 '꿈꾸던 어른이 되었나요?'가 K팝 사상 처음으로 멜론 '톱 100' 1위에 올라 리센느 등 아이돌 신곡을 제쳤다.

items.title: Reservoir Expands Its Suno and Anthropic Suits, Seeking $450M
items.excerpt: Reservoir amended its copyright and DMCA lawsuits against Suno and Anthropic to cover more than 2,500 songs combined, with sought statutory damages now approaching $450 million.

items.title: Getty v Stability ruling could allow AI companies to 'offshore' training to circumvent UK copyright law, says BPI
items.excerpt: With Getty v Stability AI back in the UK Court of Appeal this week, the BPI intervened in support of Getty, warning that the ruling could let AI firms train models offshore to sidestep UK copyright, with significant consequences for music.

items.title: Suno boss talks streaming fraud: 'AI music is not a crime'
items.excerpt: Suno CEO Mikey Shulman criticised the 'sleight of hand' of equating streaming fraud with AI music, saying Suno does more anti-fraud work behind the scenes than people realise.

items.title: Gustavo Cerati's Children Slam Remastered Video Facing AI Backlash: 'We Weren't Consulted'
items.excerpt: Fans suspected AI-generated alterations to Cerati's face in the remastered 'Me Quedo Aqui' video; his children Lisa and Benito say they were not consulted about the enhancement process. AI use is unconfirmed.

items.title: AI-powered label PaRa Music says it's identified the next big Indian regional music sub-genre
items.excerpt: Indian label PaRa Music, which uses its in-house AI platform PaRaMeter to analyse audience behaviour and demand patterns to guide A&R investment, says it has spotted the next big regional sub-genre.

items.title: RadioMatic aims to make AI-music a soundtrack for businesses
items.excerpt: Startup RadioMatic is launching specifically to supply AI-generated background music to cafes, bars and other businesses, formalising a trend of venues playing AI music.

items.title: AI 노래가 전화 화면까지 들어온다…민티파이 운영사 뮤직플랫, V 컬러링 서비스 시작
items.excerpt: AI 음원 유통 서비스 민티파이(뮤직플랫)가 통신 3사 통화 연결 영상 서비스 V 컬러링·V 프로필에 입점해 AI로 만든 노래를 전화 화면으로 확장했다.

items.title: Yamaha Releases VOCALOID7 Voice Synthesis Software, With Stronger Cubase Integration
items.excerpt: Yamaha released VOCALOID7 Editor ($129; standalone, VST3/AU/ARA2), running second-generation VOCALOID:AI for more natural vocals, adding a Voice Type control and lyric entry directly in Cubase's Key Editor.

items.title: You can now vibe code plugins for your MPC with the help of Akai's official SDK
items.excerpt: Akai's MPC 3.10.1 update opens an official plugin SDK so users can build their own instruments and effects, with Akai explicitly framing it around AI-assisted 'vibe coding' and its risks.

items.title: Blackstar just gave its ID:X Floor amp modellers Neural Amp Modelling support
items.excerpt: A free update brings NAM A2 Lite neural amp capture playback to Blackstar's three ID:X Floor units via an expanded Tone 3000 partnership, opening a huge online library of amp captures. (Marginal: neural modelling, body does not say 'AI'.)

items.title: Russia's Propaganda Machine Deploys Pro-War AI Songs
items.excerpt: A study by Ukrainian nonprofit Terrecon found nearly 1,000 AI-generated pro-war songs on Russian streaming services, aimed at stirring patriotism, aiding recruitment and even reaching children. (Off-list outlet.)

items.title: Gavin Adcock Calls Out AI Country 'Artist' River Cain & The People Who Fall For It
items.excerpt: Country singer Gavin Adcock publicly called out AI-generated country act River Cain and listeners who mistake it for a real artist, amid a wave of AI country acts on social platforms. (Off-list outlet.)

items.title: 라온에이엔씨, 스마트폰 안에서 끝내는 AI 음원분리·공간음향 앱 'RASES' 구글플레이 출시
items.excerpt: 공간음향 기업 라온에이엔씨가 보컬·드럼·베이스 등을 파트별로 분리하고 공간음향으로 재생하는 온디바이스 AI 앱 RASES 안드로이드 버전을 토큰 결제 없이 구글플레이에 출시했다. (Off-list outlet.)

items.title: MusicRWKV: A Multimodal RWKV Framework for Music Representation Learning
items.excerpt: MusicRWKV is a self-supervised music representation framework on the RWKV architecture that jointly models waveform, spectrogram and metadata, with an invertible compression module to handle long recordings more cheaply than quadratic-attention Transformers.
